items.title: Florian J. "Curly" Lizana Interview, 1966-05-18
items.q: This nigga Piku, he was the well-hewn knocked the room.

ctx.x: Where did we play? Mm-hmm. Yeah. Yeah. Pretty much any place in New Orleans is worth playing in. New Orleans? Yeah. I know we... Once the festival was to open the Silver Slipper and the Nut Club and the Lalloo and all these places here in Canada. Yep. And then...

I mean, Bain's system in this picture. 1919. You changed to Bain's system by then. I changed the clarinet. Yeah, Bain's system clarinet. It shows you. See if I can see. No, that picture doesn't show clarinet. So you changed right early to Bain's system. Oh, yeah. You must have been one of the first on that. I was one of the few that played the clarinet system. I'm trying to think of how Piku that was. This nigga Piku, he was the well-hewn knocked the room.
